question: If I control more than one object with the name Mishra needs for its meld ability, do I get to choose which one to exile and meld?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you select one object with that name to exile.
expected.answer: One card in each pair of meld cards has an ability that instructs you to exile the two cards and meld them. If you control more than one object with one of those names, you select one object with that name to exile.
